newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-TRANSVAAL STRUGGLE TO BEAT SE TVL.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-TRANSVAAL STRUGGLE TO BEAT SE TVL.

text.p: Transvaal moved closer to a home quarter final in the Currie Cup with a 29-26 (halftime 13-21) victory over South Eastern Transvaal at Ellis Park on Saturday.
However, neither the three-point margin of victory or their display would have left Transvaal fans with much hope of their team making any head way in the knock-out stages.
South Eastern Transvaal appear to be the Golden Lions nemesis following a 15-15 draw at Witbank earlier in the season.
Apart from the visitors fiery forward display it was again the half-back combination of Johan Roux and Chris Maree which caused most of the home team's headaches with a below par display.
Only poor goal-kicking from flyhalf Clive Terblanche, who missed seven out of 11 attempts at posts, prevented South Easterns from recording a historic and convincing victory.
Transvaal - Tries: James Dalton, Jannie van der Walt, penalty try. Conversion: Gavin Lawless. Penalties: Chris Maree, Lawless (3).
South Eastern Transvaal - Tries: F.P. Naude, Phillip de Lange, Chaka Willemse. Conversion: Clive Terblanche. Penalties: Terblanche (3).
